set_thread_context: set thread-local context values with shared or per-thread scope using CurrentContext.set
get_thread_context: get thread-local context values from CurrentContext with a default fallback
set_user_context: set user in thread-local context and cache FSM feature flag state for the request
check_fsm_enabled: check if finite state management is enabled for the current thread or request
get_current_request: retrieve the current Django request object from thread-local storage
